evaluation: Direct rational evaluation from explicit Chebyshev coefficient formula; no numerical LP or discovery search is reused.
adverse_obligations: The original coarse-grid witness is rejected by its preserved exact finite-class counterexample.
The final certificate wrapper refuses altered witness bytes and a claimed bound not covered by its proof.
The final certificate wrapper refuses missing or malformed proof inputs rather than interpreting failure as acceptance.
acceptance: All valid fresh exact inequalities and midpoint identities pass; all designed invalid inputs are refused. These samples confirm implementation behavior and do not substitute for the universal proof.
wrapper_note: Final wrapper path and exact invocation will be supplied by the parent; no wrapper implementation is duplicated here.
